final_protocol:
1. Keep the microcentrifuge tubes labeled DNA and ladder on ice next to an Invitrogen E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette, and prepare a single-channel pipette with fresh filtered tips.

2. Using a fresh pipette tip, transfer an aliquot from the ladder tube into one well of the E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette.

3. Using fresh pipette tips, transfer aliquots from the DNA sample tube(s) kept on ice into separate wells of the E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette.

4. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette into the open Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis unit and seat it fully in the cassette bay.

5. Close the E-Gel Power Snap lid and select the E-Gel EX 1–2% gel run program.

6. Start the electrophoresis run on the E-Gel Power Snap for 10:00 min.
